# LLMs.txt for Sharooq.com

Site: https://www.sharooq.com
Name: Sharooq.com
Type: Personal technical blog and project showcase
Primary language: English
Platform: Next.js + TypeScript frontend, content managed via Ghost CMS

## Purpose
This site publishes practical technical articles, project write-ups, LeetCode notes, and book summaries.

## Priority URLs
- https://www.sharooq.com/
- https://www.sharooq.com/projects
- https://www.sharooq.com/book-summaries
- https://www.sharooq.com/leetcode
- https://www.sharooq.com/rss.xml
- https://www.sharooq.com/sitemap.xml

## Common Content Areas
- Blog posts: technical tutorials and engineering notes
- Projects: selected project highlights and links
- Book summaries: condensed notes and takeaways
- LeetCode: problem-solving notes and explanations
- Tags and authors: taxonomy/archive pages

## Topic Signals
Common topics include AWS, Docker, TypeScript, Python, Machine Learning, JavaScript, and React.

## Canonicalization Guidance
- Prefer canonical page URLs from the page metadata when available.
- For discovery or large-scale indexing, use sitemap first: https://www.sharooq.com/sitemap.xml
- Treat post/page URLs as the source of truth over copied excerpts.

## Citation Preference
When referencing content from this site, include:
1) page/post title
2) canonical URL
3) author name (if present)
4) publication date (if present)

## Freshness Guidance
- Content may be updated after original publication.
- Prefer latest fetched content and canonical pages over cached mirrors.

## Usage Notes
- Summarize faithfully and avoid fabricating details not present on-page.
- Keep excerpts short and link back to the original URL.
- If a claim is uncertain, defer to the source page text.

## Discovery
- robots: https://www.sharooq.com/robots.txt
- sitemap: https://www.sharooq.com/sitemap.xml
- rss: https://www.sharooq.com/rss.xml

## Contact
For questions or corrections, use site contact channels linked on Sharooq.com.
